title: Function Identityinfowithsigninrisk
author: reprise99
description: Save as a function in your workspace then invoke via its name, i.e if you save as SigninRisk SigninRisk | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where UserPrincipalName == "user@yourdomain.com" SigninRisk | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where AssignedRoles contains "Global Administrator" This will join the users identity information, sign in data and any risky signins for your query
